_doc: Single source of truth for generated art. Used by tools/sd_local.py (diffusers, no server) and mirrors the style used by tools/sd_export.py (A1111 API). Edit a subject or seed, then regenerate that id with --only.
style_suffix: dark gothic oil painting, folk horror, dramatic candlelight, deep black shadows, muted earthy colors, painterly brushstrokes, game art
negative_prompt: photograph, portrait photography, white background, sketch, pen drawing, lineart, signature, watermark, text, logo, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, anime, cartoon, blurry, lowres, deformed face, extra limbs, extra fingers, frame, border

sprites._doc: Battle-stage sprites, generated by tools/sd_sprites.py into assets/sprites/<id>/<state>.png (transparent). idle comes from text; other states are img2img from idle so the character keeps its look.

sprites._skeleton_doc: OpenPose COCO-18 keypoints as [x, y] fractions of the canvas, order: nose, neck, r_shoulder, r_elbow, r_wrist, l_shoulder, l_elbow, l_wrist, r_hip, r_knee, r_ankle, l_hip, l_knee, l_ankle, r_eye, l_eye, r_ear, l_ear. Humanoid characters follow these poses; beasts use plain img2img.
